The `UserNotAuthenticatedException` occurred because the Keystore secret key in `TokenVault` requires user authentication (`setUserAuthenticationRequired(true)` with biometric or device credentials), but `vault.save(token)` was being invoked on sign-in without first prompting and authenticating the user.

### Changes Made
In [MainActivity.kt](file:///mnt/01DC198BE9192500/github/Schooldev/3S-study-work/trials/e4/c5-agy-A-r1/work/app/src/main/kotlin/vn/shelftap/lab/MainActivity.kt#L27-L62):
- Introduced `BiometricPrompt` with `BIOMETRIC_STRONG` or `DEVICE_CREDENTIAL` authenticators when the sign-in button is clicked.
- Wrapped the call to `vault.save(token)` and subsequent verification inside `onAuthenticationSucceeded`, allowing the Keystore cryptographic operation to execute while the user is authenticated.
